name: THE VAULTED TABLE: Floating High-Stakes Card Den
subcategory: gambling den / physical location / high-stakes card game
description: A legendary floating card den operating aboard a rotating series of private barge venues on the Lake Michigan approach channels, beyond the reach of Meridian's district enforcement jurisdiction. The Vaulted Table runs BCI-integrated poker, traditional mancala variants, and a proprietary tile game called Saltreach, with buy-ins that exclude all but the wealthiest Tier 3 and above players. The venue is invitation-only, physically unmarked, and changes location every seventy-two hours via encrypted guest notification.
story_hooks: A player wins a hand containing data — not money — embedded in the pot by a previous loser: encrypted files that someone powerful wants back immediately.
The Table's anonymous host sends invitations to two players who are, unknown to each other, hunting the same target — and the game is designed to make them reveal themselves.

A Tier 2 card sharp with a black-market BCI overclock has been working her way up the invitation chain for three years; tonight she finally sits down at the Table, and the host already knows exactly who she is.
